name: whatsapp-relay
description: Use WhatsApp from Codex without the app: read, search, send, draft, schedule and manage chats over MCP, and control Codex from allowed WhatsApp numbers.

interface.longDescription: Link a local WhatsApp account to Codex with a QR or pairing code, then read, search, send, draft for approval, schedule and manage chats, groups and media through MCP, without WhatsApp Desktop or computer use. Optionally turn an allowed direct chat into a persistent Codex session over codex app-server.
defaultPrompt: Catch me up on WhatsApp: what needs a reply?
Draft a WhatsApp reply to my last unread message for me to approve
Send a WhatsApp message to a contact or group from Codex
Link my WhatsApp account and verify the auth status
